text:
samir: Heads up — we should carve out time for a short blameless retro on the 3/4 incident (INC-1234). Proposing two slots: Wed Mar 18 10:30am PT or Thu Mar 19 1:00pm PT. Please react with :one: for Wed or :two: for Thu and ping folks who must attend. Pre-read: https://redwood.docs/incident/INC-1234-retro (timeline + logs + metrics).

jenn: +1 for Wed 10:30. Please include eng-sre and infra leads. Also add a "communication timeline" section to the agenda.

alex: Wed works for me. Can we keep it to 45m? Focus on follow-ups and owners. I'll prepare a short summary of the code review backlog that was impacted.

maria: I can facilitate Wed and take notes. Also volunteer to run the action-owner follow-up once we triage items.

samir: Awesome — thanks Maria. Draft agenda below, feel free to tweak. I'll ping infra leads @natalie and @chao to confirm.

```
Agenda (45m)
- 0-5m: Context + high-level impact (owner: samir)
- 5-15m: Communication timeline + who saw what when (owner: jenn)
- 15-30m: Root cause discussion + what mitigations worked (owners: eng-sre/infra)
- 30-40m: Action items, owners, and deadlines (facilitator: maria)
- 40-45m: Rollout/rollback policy tweaks & next steps
Pre-read: INC-1234 timeline + metrics in doc (linked above)
```

natalie: I can attend the first 30m on Wed, then I need to hop to another sync. I can hand off notes to chao for the last 15m.

chao: I can cover the infra side in the root-cause and action-owner sections. Thu is slightly better for me but I can make Wed.

ops-bot: Calendar invite created: Wed Mar 18 10:30am PT (45m). Attendees: samir, jenn, alex, maria, natalie, chao. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/INC-1234-retro

alex: I'll add the CR backlog slice and current status of postmortem actions to the doc before the meeting.

jenn: Can someone add the action tracker link into the pre-read doc? I'll make sure triage owners are assigned.

samir: Cool — if no objections by EOD today I'll lock Wed 10:30. Also proposing we rotate facilitator each month (maria starts). :thumbsup: if you agree.
